Subject: Onboarding - e-invoice portal & tax docs (CNPJ / NF-e)

Hi Jonas / Laura,

Thanks for the welcome call last week. We are starting the onboarding for Bravo Materials and want to confirm the exact documents you need to get our first PO paid. A few specific questions:

- Do you require the NF-e XML (nota fiscal eletrônica) for all invoices or is a PDF copy sufficient for initial payments?
- Is Redwood's purchasing entity able to accept invoices from our Brazil entity directly, or do you need us to appoint a fiscal representative?
- Are there any withholding (IRRF) or PIS/COFINS reporting forms we should include on the invoice to avoid deductions?

I attached a scanned CNPJ (CNPJ_scan.pdf) and an example invoice PDF. If there are other fields (service location, ISS code) that you need on the NF-e, please list them so we can update our billing system.

Next steps from our side: we can register the supplier in your e-invoice gateway if we have a clear checklist. Happy to jump on a short call to walk through.

Best,
Marcelo Silva
Finance & Ops Lead
Bravo Materials

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marcelo Silva <marcelo@bravomaterials.com>

Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 11:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding - e-invoice portal & tax docs (CNPJ / NF-e)

Marcelo —

Thanks for sending these. Helpful start. High level checklist for Redwood procurement to route payment without PO hold:

1) Confirmed CNPJ (attached) and invoice matches CNPJ name and address.
2) NF-e XML attached to email or uploaded to our portal for all invoices over BRL 10,000. For lower amounts a PDF is acceptable but NF-e XML preferred.
3) Invoice must include tax breakdown lines: base values for ISS (municipal service tax), PIS/COFINS, IRRF (if applicable) and ISS service code (CNAE/CFOP where relevant).
4) If Redwood requires withholding (IRRF) we will notify prior to payment. Please include your bank details and currency (BRL or USD).

Procurement process note: we will issue a conditional PO that remains in "PO-HOLD" status until the NF-e XML and CNPJ validation are completed. The hold is automatic for suppliers where e-invoice validation fails or CNPJ mismatches our vendor registry. Once validation passes, AP releases payment according to the PO payment terms.

I attached a lightweight invoice template (redwood_invoice_template.pdf) with the fields we check. If you prefer, we can provisionally accept a signed PDF while you enable NF-e XML exports in your ERP — we just need a commitment date for full XML delivery.

I've CC'd Laura (integration lead) to coordinate portal access and Karthik on tax questions.

Jonas Weber
Global Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference

Karthik / Laura — forwarding Bravo Materials thread. Key asks from vendor: whether we need a fiscal rep + whether withholding applies. My recommendation:

- Tax: Karthik, please confirm whether for service invoices from Bravo Materials we should plan for IRRF withholding and what percentage to apply. Also confirm whether PIS/COFINS reporting from Redwood side requires any additional vendor attestation.
- Portal: Laura, can we provision a vendor SFTP upload + manual portal upload for their first two invoices while IT turns on NF-e parsing? If not, let's schedule a 30-minute onboarding to get them into the portal.

Procurement escalation path: if vendor does not supply NF-e XML within 10 business days we create a PO-HOLD with an automatic 7-day escalation to Vendor Legal and Tax. That escalation triggers a payment hold and requires an approved exception from finance leadership.

I included the Drive link with sample NF-e XML schema for your reference.

Jonas

Subject: Re: Onboarding - e-invoice portal & tax docs (CNPJ / NF-e)

All — quick update from tax & compliance.

- Withholding: For service invoices we should expect potential IRRF withholding depending on the service classification and whether the vendor is subject to the tax treaty. Typical gross withholding range is 1.5%–15% depending on nature of services; we will confirm the exact code once Bravo sends the service description + ISS code. Please include the tax regime (Simples/Presumido/Lucro Real) on invoices if available.
- Fiscal representative: Redwood does not require a fiscal representative for suppliers billing from their Brazil legal entity. Fiscal rep is only needed if a non-resident is issuing invoices in Brazil or if the vendor requests Redwood to accept reverse-charge style arrangements.
- PO/Payment path: Procurement will create a conditional PO (PO-HOLD) that flags AP to verify NF-e XML and CNPJ in SERPRO/Receita validation. Once NF-e XML and bank details are validated, AP will release payment within agreed terms.

Action items for Bravo (Marcelo):
1) Please attach the NF-e XML for at least one test invoice and confirm your tax regime. (Attachment: sample_nf-e.xml)
2) Confirm whether your ERP can export NF-e XML to SFTP or if you need portal credentials.
3) If you cannot provide XML within 10 business days, vendor legal should review the contract for exception language (cc Ana Torres).

I'll prepare a short internal note with the withholding matrix after I have the service classification. For now, procurement can proceed with the conditional PO flow.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Tax & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
